name: SonaSelection India
description: SonaSelection India operates as an integrated fabric manufacturing and processing player, focusing on value-added textile products across multiple segments. It manufactures a diversified portfolio including 100% cotton fabrics, cotton lycra (stretch), cotton blends, and polyester blends, while also offering processing services for cotton, polyester-viscose (P/V), and polyester fabrics. Its business model combines in-house processing with outsourced greige fabric sourcing, enabling flexibility, cost efficiency, and consistent product quality.

name: Hero Motors
description: Hero Motors is an automotive technology and powertrain solutions provider focused on designing, developing, manufacturing and supplying engineered systems for both electric and internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles. Its products serve two-wheelers, performance cars, e-bikes, off-road vehicles, commercial vehicles and emerging mobility applications such as aerospace and eVTOL. The business is organized into two segments: Powertrain Solutions and Alloys & Metallics (A&M).

name: Jindal Supreme
description: Jindal Supreme is a steel products manufacturer engaged in the production and supply of MS black pipes and tubes, galvanized pipes and tubes, metal beam crash barriers, and GI tubular poles for infrastructure and industrial applications. Established in1974, the company operates from its manufacturing facility in Hisar, Haryana, which is equipped with pipe mills, welding and galvanizing plants, machinery, testing equipment and an in-house maintenance workshop.

name: SS Retail
description: SS Retail is a multi-brand mobile phone and electronics retail chain, with a strong focus on serving customers in Tier II and Tier III & beyond cities. It operates primarily through three brands—SS Mobile, Mobile Exchange Wala and The Mobile Space—offering new smartphones, pre-owned smartphones, accessories, televisions, laptops, tablets and related services such as EMI facilities, mobile protection plans, anti-theft software and recharges.

name: Manika Plastech
description: Manika Plastech is a design-led, precision-engineered rigid polymer packaging manufacturer serving critical industries including energy storage, automotive, paints, lubricants, chemicals, food and dairy. Its core portfolio comprises battery casings, pails and thinwall containers, supported by an automotive component painting facility. The company develops its products in-house and has registered 30 designs for battery casings, while owning more than 800 moulds and offering over 6,700 products across its portfolio.

name: Veegaland Developers
description: Veegaland Homes is a Kerala-focused residential real estate developer engaged in the planning, development and sale of multi-storied apartments across the mid-premium, premium, ultra-premium, Luxe and ultra-luxury segments. Operating under the Veegaland Homes brand, the company has a presence across Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Kozhikode and Thrissur. Its projects target a broad customer base, ranging from first-time homebuyers and upper-middle-class families to high-net-worth individuals seeking larger, premium residences.

name: ARCIL
description: Incorporated in 2003, Asset Reconstruction is a leading asset reconstruction company (ARC) in India. The company is engaged in acquiring stressed assets from banks and financial institutions and resolving them through restructuring, settlements, enforcement of security interests and legal recovery mechanisms. Incorporated in 2002 and operational since 2003, it was the first ARC incorporated in India and has over two decades of experience in the asset reconstruction industry.

name: Karamtara Engineering
description: Karamtara Engineering is a backward-integrated manufacturer of renewable energy and power transmission infrastructure products, with solar energy forming the core of its business. It is the largest integrated manufacturer in India of solar mounting structures and tracker components by installed capacity, with 8,89,200 MTPA of aggregate manufacturing capacity as of 31 March 2026, including 4,92,000 MTPA of solar product capacity, equivalent to approximately 16.81 GW.

name: LCC Projects
description: LCC Projects is a Gujarat-based multidisciplinary Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) player primarily focused on irrigation and water supply infrastructure. With over two decades of execution experience, it undertakes complex projects including dams, barrages, canals, hydraulic structures, lift irrigation systems, underground pipeline networks and multi-village water supply schemes. As of March 2026, the company had completed 80 projects and expanded its presence across 12 states in India.

name: Manipal Payment
description: Manipal Payment and Identity is a technology-driven provider of secure payment, identification, secure printing, smart tagging and IoT solutions, serving banks, fintech companies, NBFCs and government institutions across India and international markets. Incorporated in 2008 and part of the Manipal Group, its core business is built around manufacturing and personalizing payment cards, including credit, debit, prepaid, metal and recycled PVC cards, alongside cheque solutions, smart wearables, NFC/QR products and digital automation solutions.

name: Rentomojo
description: Rentomojo operates a technology-driven, full-stack direct-to-consumer (D2C) rental and subscription platform for furniture and appliances in India. The company enables consumers to access essential home products—including beds, mattresses, sofas, wardrobes, refrigerators, washing machines, televisions and water purifiers—through flexible, long-term subscription plans, eliminating the need for large upfront purchases and reducing maintenance, relocation and upgrade-related hassles.

name: Steamhouse India
description: Steamhouse India is an Indian industrial gas generation and distribution company that primarily supplies steam to industrial customers through a centralised community boiler and pipeline network. Instead of individual factories maintaining their own boilers, the company generates steam at strategically located facilities and delivers it directly to customers through dedicated pipelines. It also purchases steam from third-party generators and distributes it through its network.

name: Glass Wall Systems
description: Glass Wall Systems is a premium façade solutions and fenestration provider serving the Indian market as well as customers in the USA and Australia. With over two decades of industry experience, it has completed more than 158 projects and is the second-largest façade solutions provider in India by revenue for FY2024 and FY2025, while also being India’s largest façade exporter by revenue in 2024.

name: Kanohar Electricals
description: Kanohar Electricals is a transformer manufacturing and power infrastructure company with over four decades of experience. Its business is divided into two segments: Transformer Manufacturing and Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC). The transformer business is the core revenue driver, contributing 83.43% of FY2026 revenue, while EPC accounted for 16.44%. The company manufactures power, traction, Scott and distribution transformers, along with shunt reactors, serving power transmission, railways, renewable energy and power distribution applications.

name: Prasol Chemicals
description: Prasol Chemical company is a speciality chemicals manufacturer focused on complex and differentiated chemistries, with over three decades of industry experience. Its business is built around three broad product categories: acetone-based speciality chemicals, phosphorus-based speciality chemicals, and other customised speciality chemicals. As of 30 June 2026, its portfolio comprised more than 150 products, including 21 acetone-based, 53 phosphorous-based and 76 other specialty chemicals. These products serve five major application areas—performance chemicals, paints, inks, construction and adhesives (PICA), pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and home and personal care.

name: Pranav Constructions
description: Pranav Constructions is a Mumbai-based real estate developer focused primarily on the redevelopment of existing residential properties, with a strong presence across the Western Suburbs of the Mumbai Metropolitan region. The company follows a pure-play redevelopment model, working predominantly with Cooperative Housing Societies to demolish ageing structures and develop new residential buildings that provide replacement homes to existing residents while creating additional units for sale.

name: Kheria Autocomp
description: Kheria Autocomp is an auto ancillary manufacturer specialising in plastic injection moulding and sub-assembly operations, with a primary focus on supplying components to the automotive industry. It operates as a Tier-II supplier, manufacturing products as per specifications provided by Tier-I automotive component suppliers, which subsequently supply passenger vehicle OEMs. Its product portfolio covers interior trims, exterior plastic components, under-hood parts, and HVAC and ventilation components, catering to both internal combustion engine (ICE) and electric vehicles (EVs).

name: SpectraA Technology
description: SpectraA Technology Solutions is an engineering and process-equipment company that provides end-to-end solutions for setting up and expanding industrial process plants. The company follows a turnkey design-build-commission model, taking responsibility from engineering and fabrication through installation, commissioning and handover. Its key end markets include commercial and microbreweries, distilleries, malt-spirit producers, food and beverage processors, and botanical extraction plants.

name: Quanto Agroworld
description: Quanto Agroworld is an India-based specialty ingredient manufacturer engaged in the cultivation, processing and supply of Medicinal and Aromatic Plants (MAPs), with lemongrass as its primary crop and commercial focus. Incorporated in 2018, the company follows a vertically integrated, B2B-oriented business model covering land access, cultivation, harvesting, steam distillation, processing, packaging and bulk supply. This integration enables greater control over raw material availability, traceability, processing timelines and product quality.

name: Vama Wovenfab
description: Vama Wovenfab manufactures Polypropylene (PP) and High-Density Polyethene (HDPE) woven sacks and fabric-based packaging products. The company caters primarily to B2B manufacturers and traders across industries requiring bulk packaging solutions.

name: Century Business Media
description: Century Business Media, established in 1999, is an Out-of-Home (OOH) advertising company focused on delivering static and digital advertising solutions across high-footfall public spaces. Its operations span four key segments: Airport Out-of-Home (AOOH), Railway Out-of-Home (ROOH), Metro Out-of-Home (MOOH), and City Out-of-Home (COOH) advertising. The company holds exclusive advertising rights at five airports—Patna, Ranchi, Deoghar, Darbhanga and Jorhat—and railway advertising rights covering 714 stations across five divisions of the East Central Railway. It has also entered metro advertising through Platform Screen Door rights at Howrah and Esplanade metro stations.

name: Injecto Polymers
description: Injecto Polymers is a West Bengal-based manufacturer of flexible plastic packaging products, with operations spanning both manufacturing and trading activities. Incorporated in 1998, the company primarily operates on a B2B model, supplying customised packaging solutions to institutional and industrial customers across agriculture, construction, food, chemicals, textiles and consumer goods.

name: Maharaja & Speedex
description: Maharaja & Speedex India is a stainless-steel drinkware manufacturing and distribution company serving both consumer and institutional markets across India. The company manufactures, brands, markets and distributes stainless-steel bottles and value-added drinkware products under its own brands, “Speedex” and “Dewdrop”, while also undertaking OEM and private-label manufacturing for corporate, institutional and commercial customers.

name: Om Galaxy
description: Om Galaxy is a precision tooling and mould manufacturing company with over 17 years of experience, primarily serving the building materials, plastics and polymer processing, automotive, and industrial engineering sectors. Its core business involves designing, developing and manufacturing pipe fitting moulds, industrial moulds and automotive moulds used in injection and blow moulding applications. Through its subsidiaries, OMG Auto Mould and Infuse HRS, the company has expanded into automotive moulds and Hot Runner Systems (HRS), enabling it to offer integrated tooling solutions.

name: Panchatv Bharat
description: Panchatv Bharat operates in the denim textile industry and is engaged in the manufacturing and bulk distribution of finished denim fabrics. The company manufactures denim fabrics under its own ‘NJD’ brand through a combination of third-party manufacturing arrangements and leased loom machinery. It also procures finished denim fabrics from distributors and suppliers, giving it a flexible, relatively asset-light operating model. Its products are sold in bulk to garment manufacturers, distributors, dealers and wholesalers, with key markets including Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat and Rajasthan.

name: Raksan Transformers
description: Raksan Transformers manufactures transformers used across power generation, transmission and distribution networks. The company manufactures distribution transformers, power transformers, solar application transformers and special-purpose transformers, serving government entities, power utilities, EPC contractors and industrial customers. Its products are designed according to customer-specific requirements, including voltage, capacity, climate and system conditions.

name: Amtech Esters
description: Amtech Esters is a B2B specialty chemicals company engaged primarily in the manufacturing of Unsaturated Polyester Resins (UPRs) and the trading of complementary products used across the resin and FRP value chain. Its product portfolio spans 79 SKUs, comprising UPRs, pigments, fibre resins, hardeners, ancillary products and silicone-based products. UPRs are the company’s core product, contributing 62.84% of FY26 revenue, while pigments manufactured by its wholly owned subsidiary, Croda Pigments (CPPL), contributed another 24.14%. These products cater to diverse applications including automotive and body shops, electrical switchgear, fashion accessories, FRP products, decorative articles, coatings and other industrial applications.

name: Infrax Renewable
description: Infrax Renewable is an ISO 9001:2015-certified solar energy company engaged across three key business verticals: solar EPC services, sale of solar products and Independent Power Producer (IPP) operations. Its EPC business provides end-to-end solutions for residential rooftop and commercial ground-mounted solar projects, covering site assessment, design and engineering, procurement, installation, commissioning and O&M support. Installation is primarily executed through its dealer network and third-party contractors.

name: Vinod Texworld
description: Vinod Texworld is an India-based textile company engaged in the manufacturing, processing, supplying and trading of textile products for domestic and international markets. Its core manufacturing activities include dyeing and printing greige fabric, with a product portfolio spanning cotton, polyester and blended fabrics. The company primarily supplies finished fabrics used as raw materials by apparel and other fabric-based product manufacturers.

name: Apana Logistics
description: Apana Logistics is a logistics services provider focused on container handling, transportation and related supply-chain support services. Incorporated in 1992, the company primarily serves Container Freight Stations (CFSs), Inland Container Depots (ICDs), ports and third-party warehouse operators. Its core services include container handling at CFSs/ICDs/ports, road transportation of containers and cargo, warehouse cargo handling, and repair, operation and maintenance of trucks and trailers.

name: Qualiance International
description: Qualiance International is a Tiruppur-based manufacturer and exporter of technical and performance garments, catering primarily to government, institutional and international brand customers. The company manufactures products such as military and police uniforms, tactical outerwear, high-visibility workwear, weather-resistant jackets, protective workwear and activewear. The company primarily operates on a customer-order basis, manufacturing garments according to client-provided designs, technical specifications and performance requirements.
